host_note: Beeson (1941:347) reported Quercus lamellosa under the unresolved name Platypus uncacanthurus; not an adopted host of P. lewisi.
taxonomy_summary: Platypus lewisi Blandford, 1894. Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus uncacanthurus
taxonomic_history.note: Page 347 contains name use but not a verified available original description or adopted synonymy.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus lewisi
taxonomic_history.note: Original account pp. 134–135; original name and description verified.

nomenclature_note: Beeson (1941:347) used Platypus uncacanthurus with Quercus lamellosa, but nomenclatural availability and synonymy with Platypus lewisi remain unresolved; this historical plant association is not adopted as a host of P. lewisi.
